en: Theragāthā 1.85 Ekakanipāta Navamavagga (The Ninth Chapter) I am alone, O King, dwelling in the forest; I have no companion here. I am one who has abandoned all attachments; I am one who has attained peace. I am one who has crossed over the flood; I am one who has reached the further shore. I am one who has laid down the burden; I am one whose task is done. I am one who has severed the fetters; I am one who is free from bonds. I am one who has cut off craving; I am one who is without longing. I am one who has destroyed the taints; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. I am one who has transcended birth and death; I am one who has reached the end of suffering. I am one who has realized the Dhamma; I am one who dwells in the Dhamma. I am one who has seen the Truth; I am one who has attained the goal. I am one who has attained the Deathless; I am one who has reached the secure state. I am one who has attained the Unconditioned; I am one who has found the refuge. I am one who has attained the Island; I am one who has found the shelter. I am one who has attained the Light;

I am one who has found the radiance. I am one who has attained the Bliss; I am one who has found the peace. I am one who has attained the Coolness; I am one who has found the relief. I am one who has attained the Tranquility; I am one who has found the calm. I am one who has attained the Liberation; I am one who has found the release. I am one who has attained the Emancipation; I am one who has found the freedom. I am one who has attained the Peace; I am one who has found the bliss. I am one who has attained the Goal; I am one who has reached the end. I am one who has attained the Way; I am one who has followed the path. I am one who has attained the Fruit; I am one who has reaped the harvest. I am one who has attained the Knowledge; I am one who has gained wisdom. I am one who has attained the Vision; I am one who has gained insight. I am one who has attained the Power; I am one who has gained strength. I am one who has attained the Virtue; I am one who has gained morality. I am one who has attained the Concentration; I am one who has gained meditative absorption. I am one who has attained the Wisdom; I am one who has gained discernment. I am one who has attained the Deliverance; I am one who has gained liberation. I am one who has attained the Awakening; I am one who has gained enlightenment. I am one who has attained the Nirvana; I am one who has gained the extinction of suffering. The Verses of the Elder Sunāga:
“Skilled in the sign of the mind,
having understood the flavor of seclusion;”
one may attain a happiness free from worldly taints.
